verifier_role: INDEPENDENT (did not design or freeze ARC-01); READ-ONLY; no builder artifact repaired

drawdown_gate_assessment.detail: No drawdown threshold was preregistered for ARC-01; the builder explicitly disclosed max drawdown as diagnostic-only. ARC-01 is a DISCOVERY prereg (not a live-promotion gate); the frozen critical gates already include cost sensitivity, temporal/asset stability and concentration controls, and the promotion decision remains subject to the project's separate live-trading release gate. Absence of a DD gate therefore does not block discovery. It is recorded as a limitation and cannot be promoted to a gate post hoc.

the_72h_9_settlement_attack.detail: The frozen EXECUTABLE accounting iterates every certified settlement in (entry_time, exit_time] and hardcodes no count; '9 settlements' / 'at least 9' appear only in explanatory prose and a disclosed limitation note. Empirically BTC/ETH admit 8 or 9 settlements per 72h (millisecond boundary jitter) and SOL's historical 2h/4h schedule admits up to ~36. The prose is imprecise; the execution rule is correct.

non_blocking_limitations: ARC01_MANIFEST/SPEC prose states '72h = 9 settlements' / 'at least 9' / 'applied 9 times'; executable accounting correctly uses actual certified settlements.
ARC-01_GATES fail_semantics enumerates DIRECTION/OI/NULL controls but omits TIMING_CONTROL from the explicit list; the control plan's general evaluation_rule covers all controls.

Spec does not bind the statistical estimator module by hash; exact reproduction of G5/G6/G7 requires the pre-existing project standard src/trading_bot/backtesting/stat_validation.py conventions (ddof=1; percentile bootstrap index; one-sided sign-flip).
G10 calendar-month attribution (entry vs exit instant) is not disambiguated.

PIT contract over-claims that ANY eligible mutation must move the robust state (a single out-of-window-as-center point need not move a median/MAD state); recorded as a documentation over-claim, not an execution defect.
No drawdown gate preregistered (diagnostic only, disclosed).

Reused OI/price partitions are bound via certified manifest records; the verifier re-hashed the actual shared data and confirmed equality. The builder worktree lacked the local OI V2 dataset (environmental absence), which is not a dependency failure.
The builder (= DeepSeek) performed a crosscheck only and does not claim independence.
